confidence_notes: Anchors are holistic model estimates for July 2026 from general knowledge of Santiago's central districts; no live menus, listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and cafe anchors are moderately reliable, while hostel and hotel rates vary more with season and events. Cocktail and wine_glass were cross-checked against the beer anchor (roughly 1.8x and 1.2x) because direct knowledge of current bar prices is weak. FX is unverified: the 2026-10-15 value came from one search summary attributed to the RBA exchange-rates page, which I did not open; two follow-up searches could not confirm it and returned older RBA snapshots, so re-check against the RBA F11.1 table before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Anchors rest on general knowledge of Santiago's central districts (for example Providencia, Bellavista and Lastarria), with accommodation levels kept in proportion to the local restaurant and cafe anchors.
